title: decree pause --format json and decree resume --format json
description: What `decree pause --format json` and `decree resume --format json` print on stdout: the file that holds the queue while it is paused, and whether it is paused now. `resume` adds `resumed`: whether it deleted the file. On failure nothing is printed on stdout; the error goes to stderr and the exit code is 1. Reference: docs/reference/cli.md, Machine-readable output.

attention.description: The file, relative to the project root: `decree pause` writes it, `decree resume` deletes it.

paused.description: `true` from `decree pause`, whether it wrote the file or the file was there; `false` from `decree resume`.

resumed.description: From `decree resume` only: `true` when it deleted the file, `false` when there was none.
